reuse.why: Routes the flag through the existing getMonthActionCategories selection that every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is expressed once in the shared selection query; actions only forward the flag, and a shared MonthActionArgs type replaces the repeated inline argument types.

placement.why: The hidden-category condition stays in the single category-selection function in budget/actions.ts where the other exclusions live.

scope.why: Only the selection function, the month-wide action signatures and one test change.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; the SQL fragment built by string interpolation and the boolean positional parameter are minor readability costs.
